articles.title: 當局暫接獲6宗山泥傾瀉報告　籲市民留意風險
articles.summary: 當局話收到6宗山泥傾瀉報告，叫市民小心風險。

levels.text: 土力工程處話，由琴日到今日下晝6點，一共收到6宗山泥傾瀉報告，分別喺長洲、山頂、尖沙咀、葵涌同南灣道，全部都係細嘅山泥傾瀉。工程師已經去晒各個地點睇過，會做緊急修理。近排落大雨，佢哋叫市民小心，如果見到附近有山泥傾瀉，就要即刻走，安全嗰陣再報警。
levels.text_en: The Geotechnical Engineering Office said that from yesterday to 6pm today, it received a total of 6 landslide reports, in Cheung Chau, The Peak, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kwai Chung and Nam Wan Road, all of them small landslides. Engineers have gone to all the locations to inspect and will do emergency repairs. It has been raining heavily lately, so they urge the public to be careful. If you see a landslide nearby, leave immediately and call the police once safe.

levels.text: 土力工程處話，由琴日到今日下晝6點，一共收到6宗山泥傾瀉報告，分別喺長洲、山頂布力徑、尖沙咀、青山公路葵涌段同南灣道，全部都係小型山泥傾瀉。另外薄扶林道有一宗擋土牆護面損毀報告。工程師已經聯同維修部門去睇晒全部個案，仲建議做緊急修理工程。處方喺社交網頁話，近排天氣唔穩定，天文台預測未來一兩日華南沿岸有時雨勢好大，仲有狂風雷暴，叫市民繼續小心山泥傾瀉風險，如果見到附近有山泥傾瀉，要即刻離開，安全嗰陣再報警。
levels.text_en: The Geotechnical Engineering Office said that from yesterday to 6pm today, it received a total of 6 landslide reports, in Cheung Chau, Black's Link at The Peak, Tsim Sha Tsui, the Kwai Chung section of Castle Peak Road and Nam Wan Road, all small landslides. There was also one report of damage to a retaining wall facing on Pok Fu Lam Road. Engineers, together with the maintenance department, have inspected all the cases and recommended emergency repair works. On social media the office said the weather has been unstable recently; the Observatory forecasts that over the next day or two rain will at times be heavy along the coast of South China, with squalls and thunderstorms. It urges the public to continue to be careful of landslide risks; if you see a landslide nearby, leave immediately and call the police once safe.

levels.text: 土力工程處表示，由昨日到今日下午6時，一共接獲6宗山泥傾瀉報告，分別位於長洲、山頂布力徑、尖沙咀、青山公路葵涌段同南灣道，全部都屬於小型山泥傾瀉。另外薄扶林道有一宗擋土牆護面損毀報告。處方嘅土力工程師已經聯同維修部門視察晒全部個案，並且建議進行所需嘅緊急復修工程。工程處喺社交網頁表示，近日天氣唔穩定，天文台預測受廣闊低壓槽影響，未來一兩日華南沿岸雨勢有時頗大，仲有狂風雷暴。當局呼籲市民繼續留意山泥傾瀉風險，如果發現附近發生山泥傾瀉，應該即刻離開，並且喺安全嘅情況下報警。
levels.text_en: The Geotechnical Engineering Office stated that from yesterday to 6pm today, it received a total of 6 landslide reports, located at Cheung Chau, Black's Link at The Peak, Tsim Sha Tsui, the Kwai Chung section of Castle Peak Road and Nam Wan Road, all belonging to small landslides. In addition, there was one report of damage to a retaining wall facing on Pok Fu Lam Road. The office's geotechnical engineers, together with the maintenance department, have inspected all the cases and recommended carrying out the necessary emergency restoration works. On social media the office stated that the weather has been unstable recently; the Observatory forecasts that, affected by a broad trough of low pressure, over the next day or two rain will at times be rather heavy along the coast of South China, with squalls and thunderstorms. The authorities urge the public to continue to pay attention to landslide risks; if a landslide is found nearby, one should leave immediately and call the police under safe conditions.

levels.text: 土力工程處表示，由昨日至今日下午6時，一共接獲6宗山泥傾瀉報告。這些山泥傾瀉位於長洲、山頂布力徑、尖沙咀、青山公路葵涌段和南灣道，全部都屬小型。另外，薄扶林道有一宗擋土牆護面損毀報告。工程師已聯同維修部門視察各個案，並建議進行緊急修復工程。工程處指，近日天氣不穩定。天文台預測，未來一兩日華南沿岸雨勢有時很大，也有狂風雷暴。當局呼籲市民留意山泥傾瀉風險。若發現附近發生山泥傾瀉，應立即離開，並在安全情況下報警。
levels.text_en: The Geotechnical Engineering Office stated that from yesterday to 6pm today, it received a total of 6 landslide reports. These landslides were located at Cheung Chau, Black's Link at The Peak, Tsim Sha Tsui, the Kwai Chung section of Castle Peak Road and Nam Wan Road, all small. In addition, there was one report of damage to a retaining wall facing on Pok Fu Lam Road. Engineers, together with the maintenance department, inspected each case and recommended carrying out emergency restoration works. The office said the weather has been unstable recently. The Observatory forecasts that over the next day or two rain will at times be very heavy along the coast of South China, with squalls and thunderstorms. The authorities urge the public to pay attention to landslide risks. If a landslide is found nearby, one should leave immediately and call the police under safe conditions.

levels.text: 土力工程處表示，昨日至今日下午6時共接獲6宗山泥傾瀉報告，分別位於長洲、山頂布力徑、尖沙咀、青山公路葵涌段及南灣道，全部屬小型山泥傾瀉，薄扶林道就有一宗擋土牆護面損毀報告。處方的土力工程師已經聯同維修部門視察全部個案，並建議進行所需的緊急復修工程。 土力工程處在社交網頁表示，近日天氣不穩，天文台預測受廣闊低壓槽影響，未來一兩日華南沿岸雨勢有時頗大及有狂風雷暴，呼籲市民繼續留意山泥傾瀉風險，如發現所處地點附近發生山泥傾瀉，應立即離開，並在安全的情況下報警。
levels.text_en: The Geotechnical Engineering Office stated that from yesterday to 6pm today it received a total of 6 landslide reports, located respectively at Cheung Chau, Black's Link at The Peak, Tsim Sha Tsui, the Kwai Chung section of Castle Peak Road and Nam Wan Road, all small landslides; on Pok Fu Lam Road there was one report of damage to a retaining wall facing. The office's geotechnical engineers, together with the maintenance department, have inspected all the cases and recommended carrying out the necessary emergency restoration works. On social media the Geotechnical Engineering Office stated that the weather has been unstable recently; the Observatory forecasts that, affected by a broad trough of low pressure, over the next day or two rain will at times be rather heavy along the coast of South China, with squalls and thunderstorms. It urges the public to continue to pay attention to landslide risks; if a landslide is found near where one is, one should leave immediately and call the police under safe conditions.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong's Geotechnical Engineering Office reports on recent landslides during heavy rain and warns the public. Place names mentioned include Cheung Chau, The Peak (Black's Link), Tsim Sha Tsui, Castle Peak Road (Kwai Chung section), Nam Wan Road, and Pok Fu Lam Road.

articles.title: 駐港部隊：時刻準備為維護特區繁榮穩定再立新功
articles.summary: 駐港部隊喺「八一」建軍節話，佢哋會時刻準備好，為香港嘅繁榮同穩定再立新功。

levels.text: 解放軍駐港部隊喺昂船洲軍營開咗個「八一」建軍節嘅會。部隊嘅政治委員賴如鑫話，佢哋嚟咗香港二十九年，一路都好忠誠，會跟住法律做嘢，撐特區政府依法做事，守護香港平安。佢話部隊會時刻準備好，為維護香港長期繁榮同穩定再立新功。
levels.text_en: The PLA garrison in Hong Kong held an 'August 1' Army Day meeting at the Stonecutters Island military base. The garrison's political commissar, Lai Ruxin, said they have been in Hong Kong for 29 years, have always been loyal, follow the law, support the SAR government in acting according to law, and protect Hong Kong's safety. He said the garrison will always be ready and will make new contributions to safeguarding Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability.

levels.text: 解放軍駐港部隊喺昂船洲軍營舉行「八一」建軍節招待會。部隊政治委員賴如鑫致辭時話，駐港部隊嚟咗香港二十九年，一直都保持人民軍隊嘅本色，堅決貫徹「一國兩制」方針，嚴格按照《基本法》同《駐軍法》做好職責，堅定支持特區政府依法施政，用絕對忠誠守護香港嘅安寧。佢又話，而家香港處於由治及興嘅關鍵時期，部隊會聚力練兵備戰，時刻準備為維護香港長期繁榮穩定再立新功，特別係喺愛國同國防教育方面繼續作出貢獻。
levels.text_en: The PLA garrison in Hong Kong held an 'August 1' Army Day reception at the Stonecutters Island military base. In his speech, political commissar Lai Ruxin said the garrison has been in Hong Kong for 29 years, has always kept the character of the people's army, firmly implements the 'one country, two systems' policy, strictly carries out its duties according to the Basic Law and the Garrison Law, firmly supports the SAR government in governing according to law, and guards Hong Kong's peace with absolute loyalty. He also said Hong Kong is now at a critical period of moving from stability to prosperity, and the garrison will concentrate on training and preparing for combat, always ready to make new contributions to safeguarding Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability, especially continuing to contribute in patriotic and national defense education.

levels.text: 解放軍駐港部隊喺昂船洲軍營舉行「八一」建軍節招待會。駐港部隊政治委員賴如鑫致辭時表示，駐港部隊進駐香港二十九年，始終保持人民軍隊嘅本色，堅決貫徹「一國兩制」方針，嚴格按照《基本法》同《駐軍法》履行職責，堅定支持特區政府依法施政，以絕對忠誠守護香港安寧，護航特區前行。佢指出，而家國家十五五規劃開啟新篇，香港處於由治及興嘅關鍵時期，駐港部隊將堅決聽黨指揮，聚力練兵備戰，強化防護能力，時刻準備為維護香港長期繁榮穩定再立新功。喺愛國主義同國防教育方面，將繼續發揮駐軍特色優勢，努力作出更大貢獻。
levels.text_en: The PLA garrison in Hong Kong held an 'August 1' Army Day reception at the Stonecutters Island military base. In his speech, political commissar Lai Ruxin said the garrison has been stationed in Hong Kong for 29 years, always keeping the character of the people's army, firmly implementing the 'one country, two systems' policy, strictly performing its duties according to the Basic Law and the Garrison Law, firmly supporting the SAR government in governing according to law, guarding Hong Kong's peace with absolute loyalty, and escorting the SAR forward. He pointed out that as the country's 15th Five-Year Plan opens a new chapter, Hong Kong is at a critical period of moving from stability to prosperity, and the garrison will firmly obey the Party's command, concentrate on training and preparing for combat, strengthen its defensive capabilities, and always be ready to make new contributions to safeguarding Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability. In patriotism and national defense education, it will continue to give play to the garrison's distinctive advantages and strive to make even greater contributions.

levels.text: 解放軍駐港部隊在昂船洲軍營舉行「八一」建軍節招待會。駐港部隊政治委員賴如鑫致辭。他說，駐港部隊來到香港二十九年，一直保持人民軍隊的本色。部隊堅決貫徹「一國兩制」方針，按照《基本法》和《駐軍法》履行職責，支持特區政府依法施政，守護香港安寧。他又說，香港正處於由治及興的關鍵時期。部隊會努力練兵備戰，強化防護能力，時刻準備為維護香港長期繁榮穩定再立新功，並在愛國和國防教育方面作出更大貢獻。他相信香港會在國家發展中展現更大活力。
levels.text_en: The PLA garrison in Hong Kong held an 'August 1' Army Day reception at the Stonecutters Island military base. Political commissar Lai Ruxin gave a speech. He said the garrison has been in Hong Kong for 29 years and has always kept the character of the people's army. The garrison firmly implements the 'one country, two systems' policy, performs its duties according to the Basic Law and the Garrison Law, supports the SAR government in governing according to law, and guards Hong Kong's peace. He also said Hong Kong is at a critical period of moving from stability to prosperity. The garrison will work hard at training and preparing for combat, strengthen its defensive capabilities, always be ready to make new contributions to safeguarding Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability, and make even greater contributions in patriotic and national defense education. He believes Hong Kong will show even greater vitality in the country's development.

levels.text: 解放軍駐港部隊在昂船洲軍營舉行「八一」建軍節招待會，駐港部隊政治委員賴如鑫致辭時表示，駐港部隊進駐29年，始終保持人民軍隊的本色，堅決貫徹「一國兩制」偉大方針，嚴格按照《基本法》和《駐軍法》履行職責，堅定支持特區政府依法施政，以絕對忠誠守護香江安寧，護航特區前行，充分彰顯定海神針重要作用。 賴如鑫指出，強國必須強軍，軍強才能國安，當前百年未有之大變局加速演進，國家十五五規劃開啟新篇，香港處於由治及興的關鍵時期，駐港部隊將堅決聽黨指揮，聚力練兵備戰，鍛造過硬本領，強化防護能力，時刻準備為維護香港長期繁榮穩定再立新功。特別是在愛國主義教育和國防教育方面，將繼續發揮駐軍特色優勢，努力作出更大貢獻。 賴如鑫又相信，香港必將在融入國家發展大局中，煥發更大活力，展現更大作為，書寫更大光榮。
levels.text_en: The PLA garrison in Hong Kong held an 'August 1' Army Day reception at the Stonecutters Island military base. In his speech, political commissar Lai Ruxin said the garrison has been stationed here for 29 years, always keeping the character of the people's army, firmly implementing the great 'one country, two systems' policy, strictly performing its duties according to the Basic Law and the Garrison Law, firmly supporting the SAR government in governing according to law, guarding Hong Kong's peace with absolute loyalty, escorting the SAR forward, and fully demonstrating its important role as a stabilizing anchor. Lai Ruxin pointed out that a strong country must have a strong military, and only a strong military can ensure national security; amid the accelerating unprecedented changes not seen in a century, the country's 15th Five-Year Plan opening a new chapter, and Hong Kong being at a critical period of moving from stability to prosperity, the garrison will firmly obey the Party's command, concentrate on training and preparing for combat, forge solid capabilities, strengthen its defensive capabilities, and always be ready to make new contributions to safeguarding Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability. Especially in patriotism education and national defense education, it will continue to give play to the garrison's distinctive advantages and strive to make even greater contributions. Lai Ruxin also believes Hong Kong will, in integrating into the country's overall development, radiate greater vitality, show greater achievements, and write greater glory.

articles.summary_en: The People's Liberation Army garrison in Hong Kong held a reception at Stonecutters Island military base to mark 'August 1' Army Day. The garrison's political commissar, Lai Ruxin, gave a speech.
